text: hey uh. so a few things, all related i think. but one, i just added some more chunks to my map, the and now i press compile, and the compile is failing. i restarted, but that didnt help fix it. and the app itself is taking several seconds to start up now so i would first investigate why the compile is not working. it just worked literally before i added the extra chunks
resolution: Investigated the compile failure (= 'tools/rjit game bake') the user hit after adding map chunks. Root-caused with memory instrumentation, NOT guessing: the bake OOM'd the v8cli JS heap at ~1.36GB. World generation itself was fine (peak 490MB). The death was in the stdout transport: the 70MB packed game-file was base64-encoded via bytesToBase64's per-char 'out += chars[...]' loop (~94M ConsString rope allocations), then JSON.stringified, blowing the GC. Fixed at the architecture level (see req_1586): the bake now writes the binary game-file + asset blobs straight to disk via a new zero-copy binary fs door, emitting only a tiny manifest. Bake now PASSES at 493MB peak (was 1.69GB OOM). 5 compile-path suites green. NOT committed — bakeGameFile.ts carries another session's uncommitted diagnostic; user leads the commit boundary.
